decision_conditions:
Condition 6 of planning permission P2023/0711/FUL is re-worded by this NMA as follows:

CONDITION: A report is to be commissioned by the applicant, using an appropriately experienced & competent person, to assess the noise from the proposed mechanical plant to demonstrate compliance with condition 7. The report shall include site measurements of the plant insitu. The report shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority within three months of installation. 

REASON: To protect the amenities of neighbouring properties from undue noise and disruption.
description:
Non-material amendment of planning permission ref. P2023/0711/FUL dated 22/05/2023 for ‘Erection of replacement ground and first floor rear extensions to 30-31 Clerkenwell Green; demolition and erection of a replacement rear building and new plant enclosure to 30-31 Clerkenwell Green with incorporation of a green roof; refurbishment of Class E (restaurant) floorspace at basement, ground and first floor level; relocation of third floor rear window; external refurbishment works and associated alterations, including replacement ducting to the rear elevation.’

It is proposed to vary the wording of Condition 6 to amend the timeframe for the submission of the noise report to the  Local Planning Authority, changing the requirement from ‘within three months of this decision notice’ to ‘within three months of installation.’
